description: Ships NO CODE. Declares the Desert Ant Labs Clear (clear-studio ONNX) artifact and one model-runtime recipe, so the host's declarative lane registers enhance_speech from data alone.

tools.name: enhance_speech
tools.description: Denoise and dereverb a speech recording and return the enhanced 48 kHz mono WAV as base64, with honest coverage of the analysed audio.

skills.name: enhance-speech
skills.description: Use enhance_speech to denoise, dereverb and loudness-normalise a speech recording on device before publishing or transcribing it.
